fitting.schedule: refit once per calendar month using only strictly earlier same-season games; entire target date scored before any outcome update
fitting.optimizer: batch Newton-style diagonal IRLS coordinate updates

selection.side_rule: NRFI if p>=0.75; YRFI if p<=0.25; otherwise abstain

novelty: joint penalized entity-effect likelihood; not marginal-probability factorization, nearest-neighbor analog, boosting, tree, kernel, Davidson, QDA, Poisson or hidden-state model
tuning: single frozen configuration; no parameter grid, no threshold search, no result-driven rescue
external: closed unless development gate passes; repeated historical-seen development is not pristine external evidence
